name: 11566 · Merrick, NY
findings: ZIP 11566 (Merrick) has 120 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11566 (Merrick) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
